messages:
anika: Quick sync — planning an inference performance showcase (latency/cost + optimization notes). Looking for a 30–40m slot next week. Proposed agenda:
1) benchmark recap (hosted vs dedicated)
2) KV cache / batching changes
3) quantization experiments + perf
4) dashboards + action items
Can folks add constraints + what they want covered? :spiral_calendar:

kevin: +1. Prefer 40m. Can we include a short live repro of the worst-case tail latency? Also would like a slide with model variants and batch sizes tested.

maria: Add "per-prompt cost breakdown" to the agenda and the new dashboard link: https://dashboards.internal.redwood/infer/perf/summary — I'll post sample charts there. Note the dataset used: prod-sampled-jan.

david: Heads-up: cluster maintenance window Tue 03:00–07:00 UTC next week, avoid that. I'm OOO Wed afternoon. Options that work for me: Mon 18:00 UTC or Thu 15:00 UTC. If folks prefer async, I can write a short doc instead.

perf-bot: Calendar poll created — https://cal.poll/abc123 :calendar: (options: Mon 18:00 UTC, Thu 15:00 UTC, Fri 16:00 UTC)

sre: Maintenance overlap noted. We can reserve a dedicated pool for the session if you need isolated runs. Please ping infra-sched with `reserve-pool: infer-demo-1` at least 48h prior.

kevin: If we reserve a pool, what's the cost impact roughly?

maria: Rough calc: reserving 2x A100 for 2 hours ~= $1200. I'll make a cost breakdown slide and add it to the dashboard doc.

anika: Great — can everyone react with :thumbsup: to their preferred option by EOD tomorrow? I'll collate and lock the agenda. If you want to present, say so here. I'll also add a short checklist: infra reserve, dashboards preloaded, reproducible script, slides.

david: I'll present the KV cache results.

kevin: I'll demo the tail-latency repro and include the small benchmark script:
```
run_bench --model redwood-7b --seq 2048 --batch 4 --warmup 200
```

anika: Thanks — putting this on my calendar to finalize Fri 10:00 PST. :rocket:
